definitions.excerpt:
structure LiteralGeometry (T S : Tree) where
 X : Tree
 C : Tree
 w : RMAF.Vertex
 r : RMAF.Vertex
 qa : RMAF.Vertex
 ub : RMAF.Vertex
 uc : RMAF.Vertex
 sa : Bool
 sc : Bool
 sb : Bool
 a : Nat
 b : Nat
 c : Nat
 properT : (leaves T).Nodup
 properS : (leaves S).Nodup
 same : ∀ x, x ∈ leaves T ↔ x ∈ leaves S
 source : subtree S w = some (bottom sa sc sb a b c X)
 cherry : ActualCherry T a b
 two : (cuts S a b).length = 2
 core : subtree T r = some C
 coreLabels : ∀ x, x ∈ leaves T → (x ∈ leaves C ↔ x ∉ leaves X ∧ x ≠ c)
 bC : b ∈ leaves C
 cC : c ∉ leaves C
 leafA : LeafAt T qa a
 leafB : LeafAt T ub b
 leafC : LeafAt T uc c
 frontier : incident T (leaves X) = [r,uc] ∨ incident T (leaves X) = [uc,r]
 tailR : r.dropLast ∈ minimalVertices (leaves X) T
 tailC : uc.dropLast ∈ minimalVertices (leaves X) T
 offR : r ∉ minimalVertices (leaves X) T
 offC : uc ∉ minimalVertices (leaves X) T

def literalPlan {T S : Tree} (D : LiteralGeometry T S) : List Branch :=
 rawPlan T S D.a D.b D.c D.qa (bArc D.w D.sb) D.ub D.uc

/-- Actual current-guard filtering, preserving branch order and multiplicity. -/
def guardedPlan {T S : Tree} (D : LiteralGeometry T S) : List Branch :=
 (literalPlan D).filter (currentGuard T S)

def ChildQueryCorrect (T S : Tree) (child : Branch) (q : Nat)
 (answer : Option (List (List Nat))) : Prop :=
 (∀ G, answer = some G → agreement T S G = true ∧ Refines G child.partition ∧
   G.length-child.partition.length ≤ q) ∧
 ((∃ G, agreement T S G = true ∧ Refines G child.partition ∧
   G.length-child.partition.length ≤ q) → ∃ G, answer = some G)

def guardedQuery {T S : Tree} (D : LiteralGeometry T S) (q : Nat)
 (solve : Branch → Nat → Option (List (List Nat))) : Bool :=
 (guardedPlan D).any fun child => if paid child ≤ q then (solve child (q-paid child)).isSome else false

def swappedGuardedPlan {T S : Tree} (D : LiteralGeometry T S) : List Branch :=
 (guardedPlan D).map swapBranch

inductive Role where | target | source deriving DecidableEq,Repr
structure Branch where
 role : Role
 originalCuts : List RMAF.Vertex
 partition : List (List Nat)
 deriving DecidableEq,Repr

def current (T S : Tree) (c : Branch) : Tree := if c.role = .source then S else T
def paid (c : Branch) := c.originalCuts.length
def sourceForest (T S : Tree) (c : Branch) := OutputState.sourceForest (current T S c) c.partition

def hardBranch (S : Tree) (a b : Nat) : Branch := ⟨.source,cuts S a b,pendantPartition S a b⟩
def bBranch (S : Tree) (b : Nat) (qb : RMAF.Vertex) : Branch := ⟨.source,[qb],singletonPartition S b⟩
def targetBranch (T : Tree) (qs : List RMAF.Vertex) : Branch := ⟨.target,qs,arcPartition T qs⟩
def typeIBranches (T S : Tree) (a b : Nat) (qa qb q r : RMAF.Vertex) :=
 [hardBranch S a b,bBranch S b qb,targetBranch T [qa,q],targetBranch T [qa,r]]
def typeIIBranches (T S : Tree) (a b : Nat) (qa qb : RMAF.Vertex) (qs : List RMAF.Vertex) :=
 [hardBranch S a b,bBranch S b qb,targetBranch T (qa::qs)]

/-- This executable guard retains original nonroot valid distinct arcs and
checks the exact current source partition, embeddings and nonredundant cost.
No saving or safe-cover premise appears in this guard. The geometric caller
must prove it for its materialized literal branches. -/
def currentGuard (T S : Tree) (c : Branch) : Bool :=
 decide c.originalCuts.Nodup &&
 c.originalCuts.all (fun q => !q.isEmpty && (subtree (current T S c) q).isSome) &&
 partitionCheck (leaves (current T S c)) c.partition &&
 pairwiseEmbeddings (current T S c) c.partition &&
 (c.partition.length == paid c + 1) &&
 (c.partition == arcPartition (current T S c) c.originalCuts)

def callbackRequests (q : Nat) (cs : List Branch) : List Nat :=
 cs.filterMap fun c => if paid c ≤ q then some (q-paid c) else none
def orient (s : Bool) (A B : Tree) : Tree := if s then .node B A else .node A B

def AX (sa : Bool) (a : Nat) (X : Tree) := orient sa (.leaf a) X
def VC (sa sc : Bool) (a c : Nat) (X : Tree) := orient sc (AX sa a X) (.leaf c)
def bottom (sa sc sb : Bool) (a b c : Nat) (X : Tree) := orient sb (VC sa sc a c X) (.leaf b)
def aArc (w : RMAF.Vertex) (sa sc sb : Bool) := w ++ [sb,sc,sa]
def xArc (w : RMAF.Vertex) (sa sc sb : Bool) := w ++ [sb,sc,!sa]
def cArc (w : RMAF.Vertex) (sc sb : Bool) := w ++ [sb,!sc]
def bArc (w : RMAF.Vertex) (sb : Bool) := w ++ [!sb]
def vRoot (w : RMAF.Vertex) (sb : Bool) := w ++ [sb]

def cSideEdges (T : Tree) (b c : Nat) : List RMAF.Vertex :=
 (cuts T b c).filter fun q => (subtreeLabels T q.dropLast).contains c && !(subtreeLabels T q.dropLast).contains b

def rawPlan (T S : Tree) (a b c : Nat) (qa qb ub uc : RMAF.Vertex) : List Branch :=
 match cSideEdges T b c with
 | q::r::_ => typeIBranches T S a b qa qb q r
 | _ => match bSideWithoutA T a b c with
   | [] => typeIIBranches T S a b qa qb [lca ub uc]
   | qs => typeIIBranches T S a b qa qb qs

def arcPartitionFrom (T : Tree) : List RMAF.Vertex → List (List Nat) → List (List Nat)
 | [],P => P
 | q::qs,P => arcPartitionFrom T qs (splitForest P (subtreeLabels T q))
def arcPartition (T : Tree) (qs : List RMAF.Vertex) := arcPartitionFrom T qs [leaves T]

def OriginalCover (T S : Tree) (F : List (List Nat)) (P : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
 ∃ G, agreement T S G = true ∧ G.length ≤ F.length ∧ Refines G P

def swapRole : Role → Role | .target => .source | .source => .target
def swapBranch (c : Branch) : Branch := { c with role := swapRole c.role }

def singletonPartition (S : Tree) (a : Nat) : List (List Nat) :=
 [[a],(leaves S).filter fun x => x != a]

def ActualCherry (T : Tree) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, CherryAt T p a b ∨ CherryAt T p b a

def lca : Vertex → Vertex → Vertex
  | [], _ => []
  | _, [] => []
  | s :: a, t :: b => if s = t then s :: lca a b else []

open RMAF CoreGraph Integration VertexGeometry CutRealization HardParent

/-- Literal generic source-edge split of every original agreement block. -/
def splitForest (F : List (List Nat)) (X : List Nat) :=
 BinaryExchange.splitAll F X.contains

interpretation: LiteralGeometry is a supplied original graph input shape, not the globally proved selector classification. All original hull vertices retained. originalCuts lists remain ordered/multiple occurrences; paid is literal cut-list length. A query returns feasibility under explicit per-affordable-child ChildQueryCorrect, not an implemented minimum solver. No author fixture or intended optimum is supplied.
